condition.title: Problem
condition.p: I received a Document could not be loaded error message when trying to open a document.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: If the document is stored on a file server that uses HTTPS, the server might use a self-signed or invalid certificate.

steps-informal.p:
If you encounter this issue, an administrator can:
Go to the Administration Page and click on Connection.
Select the Automatically accept a security certificate, even if invalid option.
Click Apply.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: If the document fails to load with the Document could not be loaded message after a long wait (for example, 30 to 60 seconds), there might be a reverse proxy server in front of that times out.
To confirm this issue, a system administrator should check the browser's Developer Tools Network tab for a failed request with status code 504 (Gateway Timeout).

steps-informal.p: Configure the reverse proxy with a longer timeout, or troubleshoot why the document takes too long to load.
